annotatedSteps.description: Formulating the equation for the total volume of the toy
annotatedSteps.studentWork:
Let the height of the cone be h cm, r = 3.5 cm.
Volume of toy = volume of cone + volume of hemisphere
166 5/6 = 1/3 πr²h + 2/3 πr³
